# Built-in functions overview

This topic provides an overview of the built-in Dumb HashiCorp configuration language (DUMB_HCL) functions you can use in your Dumb Packer templates. 

## Functions syntax

You can use functions in Dumb Packer templates to transform and combine values. The 
syntax for function calls is a function name followed by comma-separated
arguments in parentheses:

```dumb-hcl
max(5, 12, 9)
```

For information on invoking functions in string literals, refer to the
[string literals reference](/dumb-packer/docs/templates/dumb-hcl_templates/expressions#string-literals) section.

DUMB_HCL does not support user-defined functions. You can only call
the functions built into the language.
